text:
sam: Quick heads-up — noticed ~3.2% drop in prefix cache hit-rate after yesterday's runtime push (commit abc1234). Can we do a quick sync + bench A/B? :eyes:

olivia: Ugh. Where's the grafana link and window? also which routes/tenants are affected?

sam: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/prefix_cache?from=2026-03-16T23:30Z&to=2026-03-17T03:00Z
baseline before deploy = 78.4% -> after = 75.2% around 02:12 UTC. spike aligns with rollout of runtime/opt-sync PR (https://gh.redwood/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/456) commit abc1234. Affected: production default model routes (mostly chat-gen).

zane: Can we run the small kv workload A/B on ring-23? I'll push a canary. Command I use:
```bash
./bench/run_kv_workload.sh \
  --target ring-23 \
  --seed 42 \
  --duration 10m \
  --prefix-sample 0.2 \
  --workload chat-heavy
```

bench-bot: Started run id run-20260317-119 (nodes: ring-23, config: prefix-sample=0.2) :gear:

maria: I'll run same on canary-2 and collect kv-stats + eviction hist. ping me when bench-bot posts results. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: run run-20260317-119 finished — summary attached (s3://bench-results/run-20260317-119/summary.json)

maria: Quick numbers from canary-2: hit_rate=75.1%, eviction_rate up 18%, avg_kv_latency +6ms. KV slot compaction rate looks unchanged. Raw: 75.1 / 18% / +6ms. I can upload flame graphs if useful.

sam: ok that's close to prod drop. zane — did the PR change the prefix sampling/compression logic? I skimmed, saw small reorg of slot allocator in abc1234.

zane: The PR refactors slot packing for better tail latency; I didn't touch prefix-sample but did change compact_cycle to use opportunistic-fast-path. Maybe that increased short-lived evictions. Opening a revert PR for the compact path: https://gh.redwood/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/459 — PTAL. :eyes:

olivia: Can you run `kv-stats --node canary-2 --histogram` and post top-10 keys by evictions? Might be hot prefixes getting evicted more.

maria: Pasted top 3 lines:
key_prefix: "chat/conv/stream" evictions: 412
key_prefix: "embeds/large" evictions: 389
key_prefix: "user/prefix:temp" evictions: 210

zane: I pushed a diagnostic patch to log compaction decisions (branch diag/compaction-logs). If revert sounds heavy we can toggle `runtime.compact_fast_path=false` in config and redeploy.

deploy-bot: scheduled config update to canary-2: runtime.compact_fast_path=false at 1849800700 UTC (initiated by olivia)

maria: After toggle: canary-2 hit_rate bumped to 77.9% in 8m, eviction_rate down 12%. Looks promising.

sam: Great. Please hold on full rollout until we validate across two rings. If results hold, we'll include config toggle in rollback PR or ship fix in next patch. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
